PROJECTS.title: Neural Stock Forecasting
PROJECTS.description:
An interactive web app that predicts stock prices using deep learning (LSTM & GRU networks).
 The app pulls real time financial data from Yahoo Finance, preprocesses it into time series sequences, trains neural networks, then forecasts future prices.
 Deployed with Streamlit Cloud for easy user access.
PROJECTS.summary: A Streamlit app that uses LSTM and GRU networks to forecast stock prices from Yahoo Finance time-series data.

PROJECTS.title: RSVP Reading Interface
PROJECTS.summary: A browser-based implementation of Rapid Serial Visual Presentation (RSVP), displaying words sequentially at adjustable rates with fixed focal-character alignment. Playback navigation, progress tracking, and persistent text storage support exploration of digital reading interfaces.

PROJECTS.title: Repository Navigation Tool
PROJECTS.description: A Python-based command-line tool that generates a hierarchical tree of a repository and integrates with VS Code for file access. It uses recursive directory traversal with depth control to create the tree and system-level process management to open files externally. Employs cross-platform abstractions to handle file I/O, process execution, and error handling consistently across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
PROJECTS.summary: A cross-platform Python CLI that displays repository trees, controls traversal depth, and opens files in VS Code.

PROJECTS.title: YouTube Playback Control
PROJECTS.description: A Chrome extension that cleans up YouTube links by stripping out auto-generated Mix playlists and autoplay parameters. Built with Manifest V3, it uses the Declarative Net Request API and webNavigation listeners to normalize short youtu.be links, remove start_radio flags, and block “Mix” playlists (list=RD…). This ensures users are redirected to the intended standalone video without unwanted continuous playback.
PROJECTS.summary: A Manifest V3 Chrome extension that removes Mix playlists and autoplay parameters from YouTube links.

PROJECTS.title: Procedural Arithmetic Practice
PROJECTS.description: A single-page math game built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It uses modular views for menus, setup, gameplay, and leaderboards, with dynamic DOM updates controlling state. Highscores and leaderboards are persisted in localStorage, timers run via setInterval, and math problems are generated randomly within specified ranges. Sound effects are implemented using the Web Audio API.
PROJECTS.summary: A randomly generated maths game with configurable rounds, local leaderboards, and Web Audio sound effects.
